name: voice_fleet_fleet_today

name: voice_fleet_recent_outcomes
description: Recent call outcomes (limit 1-50).

name: voice_fleet_outbound_status
description: SI Assistant outbound status.

name: voice_fleet_approval_status
description: Status of a prepared contact request by id.

name: voice_fleet_email_replies
description: Recent email replies (ids only).

name: voice_fleet_prepare_call
description: Prepare an outbound call for human approval (body passed through).

name: voice_fleet_prepare_text
description: Prepare an SMS for human approval (body passed through).

name: voice_fleet_prepare_email
description: Prepare an email for human approval (body passed through).

name: voice_fleet_commit
description: Commit an approved contact. Give confirmToken, or id to fetch it via the confirm-token hand-off.

name: voice_fleet_cancel
description: Cancel a prepared contact request.

name: voice_fleet_capabilities
description: Fleet capability flags.

name: voice_fleet_commit_call_live
description: Commit an approved call as a live, steerable call. Give confirmToken or id.

name: voice_fleet_live_call_status
description: Live call status and transcript turns after index.

name: voice_fleet_live_call_instruct
description: Send guidance text (1-2000 chars) to a live call.

name: voice_fleet_call_direct
description: Open-line call: dial any number now from (909) 555-0113 as a live, steerable call (needs calls:direct). No DOB/approval. Returns sessionId for live_call_status/instruct/end.

name: voice_fleet_operator_prepare_call
description: Operator line: prepare a generic outbound agent call (no patient/ticket fields) for Wayne's human approval. Does not dial. Send purpose OR scenario_id (A1-A10; server fills purpose from the scenario pack). Returns approval id.

purpose.description: Call purpose/instructions (1-4000 chars). Omit when scenario_id is set (server rejects a purpose that differs from the scenario goal).

callerScript.description: Optional caller script/persona the agent follows (1-8000 chars); its first line is spoken as the opening unless openingLine is set

openingLine.description: Optional exact first line the agent speaks (1-500 chars)

language.description: Optional language code, e.g. en, es

maxDurationSec.description: Hard stop in seconds, >=30 and <= server max (OPERATOR_LINE_MAX_CALL_MINUTES, default 3600)

name: voice_fleet_operator_commit_call
description: Operator line: after Wayne approves, place the call live (steerable). Give id (approval id) or confirmToken. Returns sessionId.

name: voice_fleet_get_transcript
description: Full ordered transcript of an operator-line call by sessionId (preparing token only).

name: voice_fleet_live_call_end
description: End a live call.

name: voice_fleet_operator_inbound_get
description: Operator line: inbound call record by Twilio CallSid (CA + 32 hex). Needs operator:call. PHI masked unless includeContent.

includeContent.description: Default false. true = return transcript turns / message body / voicemail transcription unredacted (phones still last-4; media/recording URLs dropped)

name: voice_fleet_operator_sms_get
description: Operator line: inbound SMS/MMS record by MessageSid (SM|MM + 32 hex). Needs operator:call. Body redacted unless includeContent.

includeContent.description: Default false. true = return transcript turns / message body / voicemail transcription unredacted (phones still last-4; media/recording URLs dropped)

name: voice_fleet_operator_voicemail_get
description: Operator line: voicemail record by RecordingSid (RE + 32 hex). Needs operator:call. Transcription redacted unless includeContent; URLs dropped.

includeContent.description: Default false. true = return transcript turns / message body / voicemail transcription unredacted (phones still last-4; media/recording URLs dropped)

name: voice_fleet_operator_sms_send
description: Operator line: send an SMS from the operator number (no hours window, no caps). To Wayne's cell (OPERATOR_OWNER_NUMBER) it sends immediately; any other number creates a pending approval. Opt-out always blocks. Same idempotency_key sends once. Needs operator:call (Remix operator-line/sms/send).

idempotency_key.description: 1-200 chars, stable per intended text (e.g. call SID + purpose)
